entries.EAreaType/CircleOfCultists/Tooltip: Cultist Circle bonuses The value of each sacrificed item is added up. This total determines the value of items received as a Gift from the cultists. If the value of a single sacrifice is above a certain threshold, there is a chance to receive items needed for active tasks and unfinished Hideout zones. The value of the Gifts is further increased by the bonuses. The cultists cannot deliver their Gift while you are in the Hideout. Bonuses: — Sacrificing a Sacred Amulet increases the Gift's value by {0}% — The Hideout Management skill increases the bonus of Sacred Amulet

entries.68bfea10befab555234f24e7: A.P.: Friends! Who’s still out there? Dmitry Sergeevich, come in and close the door, please. Thank you. Are all departments represented? I see they are. Let us begin, then.
entries.68bfea81ace495db5dd420fe: A.P.: By now, everyone’s noticed that communications have been down since this morning and many divisions are in lockdown. I’d like to say this is just another drill, but this time it’s very serious.
entries.68bfead59f35304935f45ccf: A.P.: We received an order from New York today. We’re evacuating.
entries.68c004e2955985870577e03c: A.P.: All projects in Tarkov are being shut down, including affiliated enterprises. From now on, contact with them will be handled only through… hmm… Gennady Viktorovich, I don’t see you, raise your hand, please. There, that’s the man you’ll need.
entries.68c004eb1f214220734a84b8: A.P.: Quiet, colleagues! I understand your concern, but we have to stay focused. I initiated the protocol a few hours ago. The specialists are already working on data destruction and sealing the premises.
entries.68c00568392d494177787911: A.P.: I believe there shouldn’t be any issues. Those drills we ran weren’t for nothing…
entries.68c0059893024df9cf45f900: A.P.: Pyotr Alekseevich, please, hold your questions…
entries.68c005e22151a721182c6134: A.P.: You’ll be able to ask your questions at the end, but for now, let’s stay on topic. Key personnel will be evacuated to the Health Resort — many of you have already vacationed there before.
entries.68c00612c87d44e373310e11: A.P.: It’s now being used as an interim evacuation site. Logistics, escort, and security are handled by United Security personnel.
entries.68c00644a8cf72f81458aed6: A.P.: But be careful! Our cooperation with them ends immediately after arrival at the Health Resort!
entries.68c006621e64ef2cfcc8a6fe: A.P.: After that point, a new contractor will make contact, and management strongly advises against approaching USEC operatives.
entries.68ebc08101d0cb0643451519: Question from the audience: Half of my samples aren’t ready yet. What’s going to happen to them?
entries.68ebc18858ac9a665a44a76c: Question from the audience: Excuse me, what about the large equipment?
entries.68ebc19744c2d00ba9333242: A.P.: The centrifuge has already been disassembled, literally an hour ago. Enough! Time is precious right now!
entries.68ea4b335d7b2a17b80d864b: Cult Victim: Tape #1. Time is… time is 14:09.
entries.68ea4b401a05b785a47dcba0: Cult Victim: My name’s Igor. I feel like some secret agent doing this.
entries.68ea4bd8c8f2d309335f4ced: Cult Victim: I even had to switch to analog recordings. You know, with a tape recorder. At least that way any of those freaks can’t hack it.
entries.68ea4c07aab1ea429a1a615b: Cult Victim: Yesterday someone slipped a book under my door. Creepy as hell, covered in those same symbols that started showing up around the city…
entries.68ea4c2e41e7c0ed05e50a19: Cult Victim: At first I thought it was some prank. Like, you know, that old TV show, Naked and Funny. That one sure is an oldie…
entries.68ea4c592b91da8e908eea0e: Cult Victim: Anyway, the book! I read it. Spent the whole evening on it. And it’s full of… of some serious weirdness.
entries.68ea4c6b46290038d27a7c60: Cult Victim: Not nonsense, no. More like… I don’t know, like someone knows things they really shouldn’t know.
entries.68ea4c9e8889510bfb233747: Cult Victim: Well, our Cobalt is connected to TerraGroup, and over the years I’ve learned a few things.
entries.68ea4caf785ce98c0aab45d9: Cult Victim: So these… these "Gifts" mentioned in the book sound an awful lot like some of TerraGroup’s projects. The secret type.
entries.68ea4cf2b96a40eec8a7dfd2: Cult Victim: I’m sure they tried to recruit me. Like, into some cult. Only these guys are way more sophisticated than your average Peoples Temple types.
entries.68ea4d048525e273c034c70b: Cult Victim: They think I have access to some "Eye of the World". That’s why they need me. And they’re not gonna stop at just sending a book.
entries.68ea4d316b4c67d2ace3954b: Cult Victim: I have to run. Yes… yes, I need to disappear. Lay low, maybe even in Bruges.
entries.68ea4d5bc7d5d070e9de9603: Cult Victim: They’ve been watching me. This whole time. And I thought it was just paranoia. Even talked about it with my therapist, for fuck’s sake!
entries.68ea4d635981f09c3094eba7: Cult Victim: I should’ve trusted my gut. Maybe I wouldn’t have to drop everything and run now. I…
entries.68ea5b6bcc7c899f90fa5168: A.P.: I understand your concerns! I don’t have all the information myself, but I’m confident that our new partners will be just as reliable as USEC personnel.
entries.68ea5b6e2bff0736c56a09f2: A.P.: TerraGroup has always prioritized security and will entrust our evacuation only to true professionals.
entries.68ea5b71a0dfaf2f689331f9: A.P.: Speaking of the evacuation… In 13 hours and 47 minutes, all TerraGroup facilities must be vacated. Yes, this is the first time we’re working under such a rush, but there’s no other way.
entries.68ea5b739da8063244c3c72c: A.P.: I’ve received the codes, "Braun" and "Chernigov" included… Also from Lisbon. So by the time the timer runs out, no one should be left here!
entries.68ea5b73a7a41ecce08c4f6e: A.P.: I’ll be evacuating last. Well, not just me. Korneev, are you here?
entries.68ea5b74ea2509d99a698972: A.P.: I understand, colleagues. It’s hard to realize that all production must be shut down. We won’t be able to take microbiology at all, just the data and parameters…
entries.68ea5b7666c1da892bdcfc33: A.P.: Hello? Yes, "Schliss 14"… Already… Yes… Wait, right now? Understood… Give me two minutes, I’ll find a spot.
entries.68ea5b76d221e86990817609: A.P.: Alright, one more thing, this is important! Ahem, excuse me, I have to take this…
entries.68ea5b778aa1929224c560fd: A.P.: Friends! It's an extremely urgent call, I need to step away. My apologies. I’ll be back soon.
entries.68ebc308a4c32e2d12d4fefa: A.P.: Good. Once everything is sealed, we’ll head to the Health Resort.
entries.68ebc32be4c53dcc9bd8b22d: Shout from the audience: How are we supposed to leave all this? We spent a year setting up the lab!
entries.68ebc33fca247ad6cc115f20: A.P.: Galina Petrovna, calm down! Everything will be fine at the new location.
entries.68b6da4fa4c6b15d3a5aa856: Cult Victim: The last tape ran out. I didn’t think it would happen this fast. Alright, I’ll make this quick.
entries.68b6da643eac094f2a6db325: Cult Victim: Anyway, those guys… those guys in hoods… They’re watching me. I just found a note stuck in my door.
entries.68b6da89958758ab3bdd1f10: Cult Victim: You know, between the door and the frame—whatever! It said something about the "Eye of the World", that I look through it and it looks back at me… The Priests called me the chosen one!
entries.68b6dac1931001229ba59040: Cult Victim: I need to run. I’m recording this on my way to the train station. I have to get out of here, doesn’t matter where or how anymore!
entries.68bfe3ea49ce213ef5bbe91d: Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.
entries.68bfe485ab69c3165dbe2666: Courier: This is Courier Odintsov. Personal number 22909.
entries.68bfe4b2f6c2fbe0b6f830c1: Courier: I was supposed to deliver urgent mail to Norvinsk, but the roads are fu- busy, so I’m going to be delayed.
entries.68bfe54cea9d42e405c48978: Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.
entries.68bfe58e6ee688ea3231200c: Courier: This is Courier Odintsov. Personal number 22909.
entries.68bfe5a2a4df6e8c4d32f43f: Courier: Things are way worse than I thought. Half the roads are blocked. I have no idea if I’ll make it out of Tarkov today.
entries.68bfe5c79ed44eab76e9691c: Courier: Let the recipient know not to hang up on the call center.
entries.68bfe8209001207c19920342: Answering Machine: Hello, you have reached the Rus Post courier service. All operators are busy right now. Please leave a message after the tone.
entries.68bfe82fea18902e3dbb117a: Courier: This is a complete clusterfuck! They're stopping everyone at the checkpoint, the line's already kilometers long.
entries.68bfe85b2a0d3361aff78d80: Courier: The truck driver in front of me started arguing with them, and they fucking shot him! Are you fucking hearing this?!
entries.68bfe87b6da55cc254d91668: Courier: A stray bullet hit my car! I almost fucking died! You know what, I don't get paid for this. I’m getting outta here on foot to my family.
entries.68bfe8a843ed244d2dbfef97: Courier: I’m leaving the car, all the parcels are inside. Life’s more important. If you send someone - the key… the key is under the wheel.
entries.68ea496b680155845750f646: Priest: The new masters of the world are already here, and the process has begun… The New World has started to take shape, and the Wardens have already been chosen.
entries.68ea4982dbbc029cd8cba974: Priest: Know that the Eye of the World has been watching you for a long time, and all… all your deeds are imprinted in the memory that the Wardens will carry from the old world into the new. Soon, it will be the only thing of value.
entries.68ea49bc10d60054c4314ba6: Priest: I knew you would come here. It was all foretold. We awaited the Blind One who would help us prepare everything for the Riders of the Arrival. And in you… we found him.
entries.68ea49e3857888888b31a46b: Priest: Behold the power of The Unheard before it is too late…
entries.68ea5cf776c0ede0d9c5a817: Voevoda: To the commander of the Gnezdo base. Reporting. After the combat task was completed, someone detonated an explosive.
entries.68ea5d024573d2106c48247b: Voevoda: We have casualties among USEC operators and civilians. One of ours is critically wounded, the rest have light injuries. Assistance required. I repeat, assistance required!
entries.68ea5d7dc9d0d9a159b983b7: Voevoda: Ahem… I never kept a diary. Thought it was a stupid idea. But now I feel like I should share my thoughts with someone.
entries.68ea5d80f539fdd7d8da5714: Voevoda: The Bogatyr squad got into a bad mess. Some of my boys are dead, others wounded. Maybe that is why I keep thinking this is not an accident.
entries.68ea5d893da1b5dc69d7c4f8: Voevoda: This is not only happening here. Tarkov, conflicts in the Middle East, hunger, poverty, global warming…
entries.68ea5d89efd6a99ffab2bfe2: Voevoda: People seem to be going mad! But strangely, it’s very sudden. A decent family man turns and shoots his little girls.
entries.68ea5d8bdb4e6054df0aa670: Voevoda: It's the same here. Tarkov used to be a prosperous city. People came here on purpose. Then… the sore burst and it spilled out…
entries.68ea5d905c698056dbe453c0: Voevoda: What if it’s the Earth itself trying to rid itself of the filth, this humanity virus? People only harm this planet. Maybe this is the end for all of us?
entries.68ea5d97c0a7439dc36ee052: Voevoda: I do not know. But those thoughts just keep coming. End transmission.
entries.68ea4ee50c71d440a2982df0: Moreman: I hope this comes through. I don’t know if we’ll make it, so I’m leaving this recording.
entries.68ea4eeff4ab97dd48695f67: Moreman: When we were getting to the fallback point, Yastreb totally fucking snapped and started shooting at us!
entries.68ea4ef4cb1f506ba16ab364: Moreman: We put him down fast, but we walked into an ambush: shitheads came at us from every direction. Fuck. Guess the shooting… the shooting was… was a signal, damn it. Fuck. Motherfucking traitor…
entries.68ea4ef7a9458d333c07cbd1: Moreman: We're still operational, but we got hit hard. Requesting help.
entries.68ea4ef9aa934537afaf17cb: Moreman: Listen guys, I don’t hold it against-
entries.68ea42c20a2a80403990d00a: Moreman: You don’t get it, Taran? Like a fucking mother duck! Remember how… how Voevoda got us out of the line of fire last time.
entries.68ea42e5245b3ad5b9f578f9: Moreman: Made us all walk outta there in a straight line like some ducklings. Fucking… heh…
entries.68ea431032907099d351b64c: Taran: Yeah, I remember. No one got hurt, at least. And the job was done.
entries.68ea432d9d13e24fc6e186cc: Moreman: Well I’m not saying it’s a bad thing! Who do you take me for? Our commander is like a real batya to me.
entries.68ea437e23768f893e363595: Voevoda: What are we up to here, pups?
entries.68ea4394e95ce984d2ee553e: Moreman: Comrade commander, everything here is strictly by the book! Come join us!
entries.68ea43b6b7b33d45c52dcd55: Voevoda: No thanks. Alright, get ready, we’re heading out soon.
entries.68ea3f2c338b34173ffabfcd: TerraGroup Scientist: This is Nikolay Voronenko speaking. The Labyrinth is the worst technically equipped TerraGroup facility, we have already lost contact with headquarters. Perhaps one of the test subjects cut the cable…
entries.68ea3f4de3134607b894de76: TerraGroup Scientist: The facility was stormed by BEAR mercenaries. To defend the Labyrinth I had to release the test subjects from groups 3 and 12.
entries.68ea3fadc9a693d7baf38672: TerraGroup Scientist: Judging by the sounds, only the test subjects are left outside now, I can’t hear any of the BEARs.
entries.68ea3fee8e6687c4bb654b12: TerraGroup Scientist: The experiments carried out in the Labyrinth are too important and too dangerous to lose the results. So I gathered all the facility documentation into a folder and threw it into the drain.
entries.68ea400f95d9f79ba8156536: TerraGroup Scientist: I don’t know if I’ll make it to the evacuation point… but during the chase I managed to grab a pistol from one of the BEARs. It will be a last resort.
entries.68ea6839c23ff215e422b819: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: …so. There are no exact dates yet. We think everything will start in about… three months. You and your, um, team should move in right after our signal.
entries.68ea68bdc7be47262d193787: Chepyga: And the cops? I’m not sending my boys to their deaths for nothing.
entries.68ea68c0a9ada0a918d84778: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: The mayor is aware and will take care of it. The pay is good, considering all your risks. Sponsors pay in foreign currency, just the way we like it.
entries.68ea68d82ea1b09e812f9154: Chepyga: Shit's getting serious. There'll be a lots of bodies.
entries.68ea68d872f730061c4681e4: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: Only this time you'll be able to take control of the whole city. Once the dust settles, obviously.
entries.68ea68d949c007685b23bdd5: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: There will be a lot of blood spilled, but not yours and not ours, assuming we act together.
entries.68ea68dad6cd9377c08aa7a9: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: Equipment, weapons, medical supplies — everything will be provided. Your tasks are tough, we won’t leave you without support.
entries.68ea68e9b219ba434c5e2b53: Chepyga: We’ll need more people. And waste a couple of local big shots beforehand so they don’t start nosing around. It’ll be harder if we don't do it soon enough.
entries.68ea68ec6dd81f45f0f880f1: Deputy Minister Shkurenko: If you handle it cleanly, I’ll help cover it up. After things heat up, we won’t have trouble finding volunteers.
entries.68ea68edb4edf66d6749b6ff: Chepyga: Aight. When do we get the guns?
entries.68ea68ee3c16c4ccfedd5926: Chepyga: Hey you! The fuck you doing here?! Come here!
entries.68b6dc8e96312975395afe50: Squad Leader: Operation is canceled! Fall back to the evacuation points on your own!
entries.691343ce4ded41ee2bea97ff: Squad Leader: The explosion knocked out all our electronics.
entries.69134497768350d6a4cedbc4: Squad Leader: I repeat. Our comms are out!
entries.68b6dc376444a29985459601: Squad Leader: Blast killed all our electronics — no comm with HQ.
entries.68b6dc38871052ba31637157: Squad Leader: We have lost control of the facility. Evacuate through Exfil Three towards the port... Exfil Three!
entries.68ea5149598a79eedb06884c: Squad Leader: Expect enemy contact, proceed with caution. Any non-USEC individuals are to be considered hostile!
entries.69133e6503f523df53ea3baf: Squad Leader: To all USEC... To all USEC units! Blast killed all...
entries.691340c1bb5c24fdd4327cc7: Squad Leader: Defend yourselves. Use sound judgment.
entries.68b6dbf69a46a09a1c755f05: USEC Operative: Commander! How much... How much longer do you reckon we'll be stuck here?
entries.68b6dbfa028de235e5884fe8: USEC Squad Leader: Let them set their priorities themselves. We’ve already got our hands full babysitting HVIs and hauling out TerraGroup’s docs.
entries.68b6dbfa3a0b2378a39c6f71: USEC Operative: You think they’ll manage to pull everything out on time? Even with their resources, it sounds impossible.
entries.68b6dbfac7e0a00e1b02ec36: USEC Squad Leader: For as long as they tell us to. TerraGroup still has a fuckload of unclosed facilities in Tarkov.
entries.68b6dbfae852a369ef69cff3: USEC Operative: But still, even if everything is moved out, there will be hundreds of digital drives left behind… There’s no way to evacuate something like that in war conditions.
entries.68b6dbfc0a786dba6c327834: USEC Squad Leader: They're not gonna extract everything, okay? I heard TerraGroup has some kind of weapon that wipes data from the systems. All of it.
entries.68b6dbfcc931094cdde643ca: USEC Operative: Like an EMP? Surely they’re gonna give us a heads-up, right? It would screw all our coordination.
entries.68ea55505b158349b62f392b: USEC Squad Leader: Why would they hide this from us? Even if they do end up using this thing, it'll only be after we're evacuated.
entries.68ea55514f5e2232e04de6e5: USEC Squad Leader: Without our PMC support, they wouldn't last long — they have no one but us.
entries.68ea5552705a83548ab21c35: USEC Operative: What about those “contractors” we transferred the HVIs to? They looked quite serious. No, shady too. No insignias, no patches… Who are they anyway?
entries.68ea55540998610ed57006a4: USEC Squad Leader: Or perhaps they're just an escort crew from outside the border — our guys are stretched thin here. Either way, we can't trust them.
entries.68ea5554bb3c96a1b0486d78: USEC Squad Leader: There is no info on them from the HQ, so clearly we shouldn't get involved in that shit. They might be linked to that specialist guy over at the lighthouse.
entries.68ea55554c65adb6ac6ff1cd: USEC Operative: Makes you wonder how fast TerraGroup would’ve been screwed up without us involved…
entries.68ea5556764900cda357fdac: USEC Operative: Especially now, when even some of our own commanders are straying away from their orders…
entries.68ea555862ec9eed52f766f8: USEC Squad Leader: Listen, watch your mouth! Any other situation, and I'd have you deployed somewhere far worse!
entries.69134af1579037fde7cd1e14: USEC Squad Leader: So shut up. SHUT UP!
entries.6a024f1bd301c5e32972746c: Survivor: So… if I can’t control this, then I must at least continue observation.
entries.6a02545758e6be929aaa4686: Survivor: I am Grigory Altman, supervisor responsible for sample storage aboard the icebreaker “Boreas”. The vessel was…
entries.6a025470218d5c1a5bf7143f: Grigory Altman: …was attacked by mercenaries in Tarkov waters. During the assault, sample containers connected to projects TG-Ci and TG-y were damaged.
entries.6a02548cc8fb634071d20726: Grigory Altman: In accordance with containment protocol, the laboratory was isolated from adjacent compartments.
entries.6a02549b5ba70587f1d882b1: Grigory Altman: I remained inside and administered protective compounds as a precaution against possible contamination.
entries.6a0254c11853e610201ab1ef: Grigory Altman: On the fourth day I recorded elevated cortisol levels, coughing, and mild itching. Increased dosage of the injected medication, observing improvement.
entries.6a0329c11251309f8fd0af9d: Grigory Altman: It is impossible to fully stop the leak or replace the damaged sample containers. I continue daily measurements and it seems…
entries.6a032b4718888d1ba3298dd8: Grigory Altman: …It seems I managed to arrange evacuation to a secure location where I can isolate the samples and continue observation.
entries.6a032b8db0f782913ecaa034: Grigory Altman: It’s critical to complete this before I enter the paranoia stage…
entries.68ab20085fae88be0afcb4db: MP Officer: Where do you think you’re heading all geared up like that?
entries.68ac39e2c7acc10ff3f9cf68: MP Officer: No gear past this checkpoint.
entries.68ac39f27c131960d80aa39b: MP Officer: Relax! You won’t need that on the other side.
entries.68af04ec0b70ef0836c13bbf: MP Officer: You’ll have to wait your turn for evac.
entries.68af04ec8e6b132dd87539e8: MP Officer: Stay close, follow my instructions precisely, unless you wanna end up in a body bag.
entries.68af04ecd4b6314250625498: MP Officer: The case goes to special inspection.
entries.68af04ece9f5a657482034fb: MP Officer: I think we’ve got some water over there, so you'll manage.
entries.68af04ed27395f44a591420e: MP Officer: This is a restricted area under martial law. Keep your nose out!
entries.68af04ed9a1d65a1f280d4e5: MP Officer: We’re going inside now. Eyes forward, don’t ask questions.
entries.68af04ed9bcc6342f7e775cd: MP Officer: One more violation — and you’ll end up outside the gate again!
entries.68af04efa51bf68e05550878: MP Officer: Alright, that’s your stop. Stay here.
entries.68af04efd57610338e92ce91: MP Officer: Follow the instructions to the letter. Otherwise we won’t go easy on you.
entries.68f7a70a877f834dbb759a7a: Radio: Confirmed! I confirm, the base is under attack! MP Officer: Move! Move!
entries.68f7a70b20c32a03a06c8f08: MP Officer: Movement outside the perimeter! Multiple!
entries.68f7a70c401c8a414f0ce616: MP Officer: Pasha's down! MP Officer: Hold your positions!
entries.68f7a70d0d88abb39656592e: Scav: Time to kick some ass! Scav: Let’s roll!
entries.68f7a70dc9d983e60d9772df: MP Officer: They're pushing through the center!
entries.6904ad98a1888a62342fb0d1: MP Officer: Where do you think you’re heading all geared up like that?
entries.6904ad993104bdbb0bd8c40c: MP Officer: You’ll have to wait your turn for evac.
entries.6904ad9944c45d625884a2db: MP Officer: No gear past this checkpoint.
entries.6904ad994e8431108e868eb7: MP Officer: Stay close, follow my instructions precisely, unless you wanna end up in a body bag.
entries.6904ad99b51be3abb5eca77f: MP Officer: Relax! You won’t need that on the other side.
entries.6904ad99c37c0cedb105675e: MP Officer: I think we’ve got some water over there, so you'll manage.
entries.6904aec111ef59d339d68cd1: MP Officer: Follow the instructions to the letter. Otherwise we won’t go easy on you.
entries.6904aec129ad96b469708859: MP Officer: This is a restricted area under martial law. Keep your nose out!
entries.6904aec137a8ab923554b5b5: MP Officer: We’re going inside now. Eyes forward, don’t ask questions.
entries.6904aec1e4b58fba907c5d31: MP Officer: One more violation — and you’ll end up outside the gate again!
entries.6904aefde80a4fa49e3d8856: MP Officer: Alright, that’s your stop. Stay here.
entries.6904c1afcc1045d0bfe8bdc1: Intercom: Your pass has been identified. Proceed to the security check.
entries.6904c1c40536dc4a3180a85e: Intercom: Your pass was not recognized. Try again.
entries.6904c1d6d5c446c88f27a5db: MP Officer: Turn around and fuck off unless you wanna get shot!
entries.6904c1e11cd4319b55e6449b: MP Officer: This is a restricted area! No trespassers!
entries.6904c1ed8f4963daa45111c5: MP Officer: Who the hell are you? We don't know you. Get lost!
entries.6904c1fa951e6b9766144e5c: MP Officer: This is a restricted zone. Get the fuck outta here!
entries.6904c2045f04a90b0cb4e9d8: MP Officer: You guys come in a pack deal? No groups allowed in!
entries.6904c2ae44146c2c322842cb: MP Officer: One person at a time!
entries.6904c2b97ec6ff8778b285ee: MP Officer: We don't take in organized groups!
entries.6904c2ded60c467398a53881: MP Officer: Ah, it’s you? Alright, they said you’re cleared, so go on through.
entries.6904c2ec358a45f9c8cc4a5e: MP Officer: We’ll let you through. Don't take too long.
entries.6904c2f8fceb7534fbc6fd2b: MP Officer: Go on through! Don’t just stand there — move it!
entries.6904c3087c9383f738174735: MP Officer: We were told about you. Inside, now!
entries.6904c31b56f1a449e481a09c: MP Officer: Showing up empty-handed? Beat it before we ice you!
entries.6904c33326a61e0d21ea5399: MP Officer: Quit swinging your keycard! If it didn't work the first time it won't now. Get lost!
entries.6904c3445ce61f508f2b605d: MP Officer: Stop fucking jerking the reader! Go away!
entries.6904c34ead4c3b652cb7fae9: MP Officer: Get outta here, or we'll start shooting!
entries.6904c357fd9fbe722280f659: MP Officer: What are you doing here? No one gets through at this time!
entries.6904c365a1df70240400d244: MP Officer: You think we let anyone in whenever they want? Scram!
entries.6904c36e22987d81d95be16f: MP Officer: Quit poking around! You came at the wrong time. Get lost!
entries.6904c378618e0108c2122047: MP Officer: This isn’t a walk-in! Entry is only allowed at specific times!
entries.6913325c3ae414e88e5a2460: Soldier: Over here! This way! We are leaving!
entries.6913325cddc84f8c4a5698fe: Soldier: Looks like it’s quieted down. You can wait outside if you want.
entries.6913325cf320cc1b1f1b9ecf: Soldier: Who knows when you’ll see Tarkov again. We’re leaving in one minute.
entries.6913325ddca1b106f00a2208: Soldier: After that, head into the compartment, no roaming around the ship!
entries.6911d01346e797a1aed776e3: Soldier: Over here! This way! We are leaving!
entries.691332c4a9eb2931e0f85770: Soldier: Someone’s waiting for you. Some fuck from TerraGroup.
entries.691332c5dbe53d46fc52cb05: TerraGroup Scientist: So, you made it. Managed to secure yourself a way out of Tarkov.
entries.691332c5fbc5a5433dbb5cab: Soldier: Keep it quick, we could take fire from the port.
entries.691332c67ec5c8fbd6555d21: TerraGroup Scientist: Not that it matters anymore.
entries.691332c6ab47177cf07e8081: TerraGroup Scientist: He’s always had the means to extract whoever he wanted.
entries.691332c6ec3ba64108eb06a0: TerraGroup Scientist: What I fail to see is why you refused to help Kerman recover our secrets.
entries.691332c732a1fcde7834180d: TerraGroup Scientist: Now, no one will ever find it.
entries.691332c73feda8c9d2f75bc4: TerraGroup Scientist: Thanks to you, the documents remain buried in the city.
entries.691332c792d084e5358c9ff7: TerraGroup Scientist: But surely you understand that your knowledge alone makes this problematic.
entries.69137ef2090f71bfb27eafe3: Soldier: Then get inside, you could catch a stray bullet out here. It’d be a shame if after all this you got killed.
entries.69137ef29575d687b965feb4: Soldier: Time to get out of here!
entries.69137ef2e7676e05c62ef5d8: Operative: I'm from the Lighthouse, same as you.
entries.69137ef3d61e418992908dc1: Operative: In three minutes the Zubr will be cleared out. The port and city will be destroyed. Air ETA eight minutes.
entries.69137ef5fae526ef6eb04eb6: Operative: No time to deal with you. Lightkeeper’s instructions are in the envelope.
entries.691333665750c2ea493460b8: Soldier: Time to get out of here!
entries.69133367469d78b7df95e90a: Captain: Did you truly think you could escape Tarkov after everything you did?
entries.691333678b28a4841f5f18b2: Soldier: Better head inside, don't want you catching a stray bullet from the port.
entries.69133367cbc470c5f87f97ba: Captain: Lock up behind me. Let nobody in and nobody out. Do it!
entries.6913336803a611c198b99dda: Captain: Someone has to keep them in check, and The Unheard do that.
entries.6913336846ad76c43f0dcd29: Captain: Even you could have survived had you not dug into our secrets.
entries.6913336872940925c302777b: Captain: You just don’t get it. If it weren’t for us, humanity would have long since died out.
entries.691333695ca25aff6972cc5a: Soldier: Kerman didn’t want your docs intercepted. Want a smoke?
entries.69133369a6fd369e6707ef51: Soldier: Relax. Only friendlies on board now.
entries.6913336a5d9c3c23173ba1f2: Soldier: Holy shit! We got out just in time!
entries.6913336a64c583bb571e2603: Soldier: What matters is we're alive, and now we’ll take down those bastards from TerraGroup.
entries.6913336aab4be534634b7927: Soldier: The whole world will know the truth!
entries.6913336ae25211ec81627d80: Soldier: By the way, take this! A souvenir.
entries.6913336b59a882215703cb63: Soldier: Those fucks treat us like cattle… want to control us…
entries.6913336c54c6e32fe80e7f59: Soldier: From here on, we decide our own fate.
entries.69283ede2a5132b6f356198a: Captain: That The Unheard would let you go?
entries.6924d5327d890c5d7e3ae2c9: Loudspeaker: The enemy has broken through to the loading zone! Evacuation will end in 3 minutes!
entries.6a4f7b51361b7475a6f0f74a: Announcement System: The facility has been switched to emergency power. Please remain where you are and await evacuation.
entries.6a4f7baf1044ce8c4d1e3da6: Announcement System: A power system failure has been detected. All personnel must remain at their current locations until further instructions.
entries.6a4f7bba0045bfa4b4fb5985: Announcement System: Emergency power has been activated. All personnel must suspend work immediately and await the arrival of the evacuation team.
entries.6a4f7bcd8af5dcd06cde9bd9: Announcement System: A critical facility failure has been detected, and you will all die! Are we actually using this one?
entries.6a318aa1a3afbdeaf55b578e name: Financial documents Financial reports from TerraGroup and its affiliated companies. Can be found on: • Customs • Streets of Tarkov • Interchange
entries.6a318b84fab84feb6aa71fe4 name: PMC personnel files Rumor has it that TerraGroup keeps a personnel file on nearly every PMC operator. Can be found on: • Reserve • Lighthouse • Icebreaker
entries.6a318c000357e1cc214ff8b4 name: Project documentation Documentation from Tarkov Infraline. The company officially specialized in road construction, but these blueprints clearly have nothing to do with transportation infrastructure. Can be found on: • Factory • Reserve • Customs
entries.6a318c4787bb92f2d5f13088 name: Blueprints and technical documentation Blueprints and technical documentation belonging to TerraGroup. For convenience, all of the data has also been backed up onto a disk. Can be found on: • Interchange • Factory • The Labyrinth
entries.6a318c7d1ee27abd10b8c6d8 name: Test documentation Documents detailing tests of various experimental compounds from TerraGroup-controlled laboratories. Can be found on: • Shoreline • Woods • Icebreaker
entries.6a318c87a7e717b20bcda2df name: User documentation Documentation issued to every new TerraGroup employee upon signing. Can be found on: • Ground Zero • Streets of Tarkov • The Lab
entries.6a318c87a8e42ee82c93d1c6 name: Medical documents Medical records containing research findings. Many of them are ethically questionable, yet remarkably successful in every other regard. Can be found on: • The Lab • Ground Zero • The Labyrinth
entries.6a318c88c4e0f26c1820632c name: Technical documentation Operating manuals for TerraGroup equipment. Can be found on: • Shoreline • Woods • Lighthouse
entries.FinalNoQuestItemMesasge: Unable to evacuate without the secure container with evidence for Mr. Kerman
